spanish: Y dije a ellos: ¿A quién oro? ¡Arránquense! Y me dieron, y los arrojé en el fuego, y salió este becerro.

units.es: y los arrojé en el fuego

grammarChanges: Changed 'Se arrancaron' (3rd person plural past indicative) to '¡Arránquense!' (2nd person plural formal imperative) so the Hithpael imperative 2mp (h02032024005) remains a command to the addressees instead of a narrated act by a third party.
Changed 'lo' to 'los' on h02032024008 to agree with the 3rd masculine plural object suffix on the verb.
Changed 'dieron a mí' to 'me dieron' for standard Spanish clitic pronoun placement; no change to who acts on whom.
readerNote: Chose plural 'los' over singular 'lo' because the object suffix on h02032024008 is 3rd masculine plural even though 'oro' (h02032024004) is grammatically singular.
